title: Choosing together through changing feelings

captions.physics: Discussing decisions with both wishes present

meaning: You can choose an answer together and give a promise clear terms while leaving room for changing feelings after agreement.
text: A shared reply can be clear while your response to it continues to change. The Lovers in the physical position of Vishuddha appear through discussing a decision with regard for both people’s wishes. The Emperor in energy supports a wish to give a promise dependable terms and stand behind what is said. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions makes the response mobile. Accepted consent can leave a mood time to settle: experience may follow the decision without automatically cancelling it at each new doubt or burst of enthusiasm.

For example, acquaintances ask to borrow something you share. You ask about each other’s readiness and discuss when it will be returned. **A clear promise allows a changing feeling.** Someone feels calm after agreeing, then misses the familiar object. That feeling can be named separately without accusing the other person of ignoring an opinion. Actual terms have been discussed, leaving room for a new emotional detail alongside the existing answer.

The difficulty is turning every mood into another final agreement. The other person loses track of which consent applies. Distinguishing present feeling from a materially changed condition preserves mutuality. A needed adjustment can be discussed directly; passing regret also deserves words without having to govern the promise’s entire content.
